Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Cult Fiction Comics wrote:
>
> I quit playing a long time ago and just started back up so what exactly does
> Tomb of Ramses do now? From the new card text it looks like it just gets a
> vampire out for half price and not the 2 for 1 like we used to use(abuse) it
> for.

Right. The vampire can be moved the controlled region sooner than normal
(when the total blood and tomb counters equals or exceeds the capacity),
but the he doesn't keep the Tomb Counters once he becomes controlled - they
are returned to the Blood Bank.
